name: Beyond Pricing Accuracy: A Multicriteria Diagnostic Benchmark of Neural Approaches to Financial PDE Approximation
description: This record contains the complete experimental artifacts of a multicriteria diagnostic benchmark of neural approaches to Black–Scholes partial differential equation approximation. The benchmark comprises 23 registered experimental configurations — seven primary neural configurations and sixteen targeted protocol-sensitivity controls — evaluated over 83 optimization trajectories and 15 additional alternative-checkpoint evaluations. The seven primary configurations are a supervised multilayer perceptron, a standard physics-informed neural network, a hybrid physics-informed network, a DeepONet-style branch–trunk surrogate, a Deep Galerkin Method configuration, a Transformer-inspired pricer, and a Feynman–Kac stochastic-target pricer. For every trajectory the record provides: aggregate evaluation metrics (160 quantities covering price accuracy, Delta, Gamma and Vega accuracy, PDE residual distribution, financial-admissibility frequencies and severities, and computational cost); regime-wise metrics over six overlapping subsets of the frozen test set; pointwise test predictions for all 20,000 test observations; the training history; the retained model checkpoint; the per-trajectory configuration in JSON; and a verified completion marker.
